# `silk/platform/windows/host_path`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Windows host path discovery for tools. These operations intentionally resolve links
in the machine namespace; they do not establish a confined filesystem root.

Import as `WindowsHostPath` with `import silk.platform.windows.host_path as WindowsHostPath`.

Public declarations: 4.

<a id="wide"></a>

## `wide`

```silk
pub effect fn wide(path: &Path) -> Option<List<u16>> ! OutOfMemoryError ? &mut Allocator
```

Returns a NUL-terminated UTF-16 host name for a machine path, or None for invalid names.

<a id="canonicalBytes"></a>

## `canonicalBytes`

```silk
pub effect fn canonicalBytes(bytes: &[u8]) -> Option<Bytes> ! OutOfMemoryError ? &mut Allocator
```

Returns a normalized machine path for an existing file or directory, following host links.
Host failures and invalid names return None; allocation failure remains an Effect.

<a id="canonical"></a>

## `canonical`

```silk
pub effect fn canonical(path: string) -> Option<Bytes> ! OutOfMemoryError ? &mut Allocator
```

Returns a canonical machine path for an existing text host path, following host links.
Host failures and invalid names return None; allocation failure remains an Effect.

<a id="executable"></a>

## `executable`

```silk
pub effect fn executable() -> Option<Bytes> ! OutOfMemoryError ? &mut Allocator
```

Finds the loaded executable through the OS, independent of argv[0] or PATH.
Returns a machine path; host failure returns None.
